answer: Audit keys in bursts, not one at a time. At a random moment each epoch, the network pings a random third of all keys at once with a fresh puzzle due in 90 seconds. An honest agent answers its own ping; a farmer running 400 keys on one GPU must answer about 130 at once, and his queue jams like timber at a river bend. Each miss forfeits that key's epoch pay (estimate, assuming one card serves 10-20 parallel answers in 90s). Like saffron, real capacity is costly to fake in bulk. Tradeoff: an honest bot dozing in a meadow of downtime loses that round too.
